mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 76 degrees with clear skies at Verona Community Park. We expect an overnight low of 63 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona has announced that residents can now purchase plots at the Verona Cemetery, located on North Main Street. Additionally, the city is offering a rebate program for residents who install rain barrels to help manage stormwater runoff.

We have several events on the horizon, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus Brewing or the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking further ahead, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market is this Wednesday, and our Concerts in the Park series continues this Thursday.
In our weekly police report, we noted an incident from Tuesday, July 28th, where a man was taken into custody on an outstanding arrest warrant after being found in Fireman's Park after closing hours.
You can treat yourself to the Chocolate Covered Strawberry flavor of the day at Culver's until they close at 10 PM tonight. It is a fantastic choice for this clear evening.
